title: Training Note on Cancelling a Security Deposits Assessment
content:
This training note sets out when an assessment under Security Deposits is cancelled and what becomes of payments already made.

## The rule

An assessment is cancelled when the service application is withdrawn before the meter is energized, or when an assessment made on the wrong tier or basis is replaced by a corrected one before any payment. Payments already posted on a cancelled application's deposit are refunded by check within the tier's cancellation refund days, counted in calendar days. A deposit on an energized account is never cancelled; it is refunded or applied.

## Questions answered

**When does withdrawing an application cancel the deposit?**
When the withdrawal comes before the meter is energized. The deposit may then be in assessed, partially paid or held status; each is cancelled.

**When may a mistaken assessment be cancelled?**
When it was made on the wrong tier or the wrong basis and is replaced by a corrected one before any payment has posted on it.

**What happens to money already paid on a withdrawn application's deposit?**
It is refunded by check within the tier's cancellation refund days in calendar days.

**The meter has already been energized and the member no longer wants the deposit. Can it be cancelled?**
No. A deposit on an energized account is refunded or applied under those rules, never cancelled.

## Hypothetical illustration

A member applies for new service at a lake cabin; a Seasonal Residence Deposit of $150.00 is assessed and paid in full, and the member withdraws the application before the meter is set. The assessment is cancelled and the $150.00 is refunded by check within 10 calendar days.
